QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_46

question.text: A Cat III AIF launching a NEW SCHEME must:

answer.text: File PPM with SEBI within 30 days prior to launch along with scheme fees
File PPM with SEBI within 60 days post-launch
Obtain unanimous LP consent from existing schemes

explanation.text: The Logic: CTR row on New Scheme: the PPM of the new scheme must be filed with SEBI WITHIN 30 DAYS PRIOR to launch of the new scheme, along with scheme fees. (Does not apply to Large Value Funds floated for Accredited Investors.) The Trap: 60-day post-launch (B) reverses the timing. Unanimous LP consent (C) is not a requirement. RBI pre-clearance (D) confuses with FEMA. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C/D test the same new-scheme PPM-filing rule. Manager's Pro-Tip: Align launch-day with the 30-day PPM-filing receipt window. Scheme fees are per-scheme, and LVF-AI schemes are exempt from the scheme-fee requirement — structure LVF-AI if launching multiple LVF schemes.
